Results.ReviewText: I hesitated to purchase this grill because of the price, there were cheaper options for sure.  I finally pulled the trigger after reading numerous on-line reviews of other Weber grills and talking to family members who owned Weber grills.  I have not regretted my purchase decision for one second. This grill outstanding!  The quality and construction are excellent.  The assembly instructions are first rate.  Assembling this grill took some time but every step was explained and no "remanufacturing" was required as every part, screw, nut and washer fit just as described.  Once it was assembled, it worked first time and has worked every time since.  No problems, no issues.  Grilling on this grill has produced excellent food so far. (any issues have been my fault not the grill's).  I am continuing to learn how to better use this grill and it is a great journey!  If you are thinking of buying this grill, stop thinking and do it.  You will not be sorry!
Results.Title: The Spirit II E-310 grill is outstanding!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This unit replaced a 15 yo Genesis with the extra side burner and the lower storage cabinet.  While the old Genesis, started with one click, cooked great meals  evenly all the time, we took very good care maintaining the it over the years, it was just too big for our tiny space on the Cape.   Sadly we sold it and purchased the Spirit 310, while it looks great in our space, a whole lot lighter to move around, starts rapidly, gets to high temperature quickly, sears meats beautifully and cooks very well too; the only down side, no hidden storage, and a smaller  cavity between the food and hood.  I miss my old grill and our landscape isn’t the same anymore, I see many happy years with this Spirit 310.
Results.Title: Smaller grill, but BIG results....

Results.ReviewText:
I am thrilled with this grill. I have had  people tell me, if you’re going to buy a grill buy a Weber.  I kind of poo-pooed them.  Anyway, my son had a huge accomplishment and I wanted to give him something special, and he needed a grill.  So I did it.  I went all the way and purchased a Weber for him.  I was so impressed with its performance, I went and purchased one for myself.  I have never made such amazing steaks !  ITS GOT TO BE A WEBER!  (Who’da thought ). LOL. Thank you for the amazing product !  
I do have one small complaint,  would it  be possible to change the design of your Weber grill cover to reduce the possibility of the wind getting under the cover.  I have already lost my cover!  The wind got under it and took it away :-(. Maybe adding a hook of some sort that attaches the cover to the grill?  Anyway. Thank you again 
My friends now joke with me, do you own stock in Weber ..... yes, I’m telling everyone about your superior product and performance !!!
Results.Title: PURCHASE A WEBER !  It IS worth the extra pennies

Your feedback on the cooking grates and the control knobs is greatly appreciated. Those grates are actually "Reversible." Reversible cooking grates empower you to be even more creative while you grill. The thin flat side of the cooking grate is ideal for more delicate food, such as fish and shrimp. The wider ridged side creates thick sear marks enhancing the flavor of your food! Please know that a 10-year warranty backs this unit. If you have any questions or concerns during this time frame, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team. Thanks!

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
